description: Story 21.7 — « Portail client » (module client-portal, free): an end client of the merchants (never a Keevo user) signs in with a code sent to his phone and lists the invoices every merchant issued to that phone. Public paths (no merchant JWT): the portal has its own session token 'kvc_…' (30 days), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer kvc_…' on GET /api/v1/portal/invoices only. A merchant JWT is refused there (401 PORTAL_SESSION_INVALID) and the portal token is refused everywhere else. The merchant's switch is the module client-portal in « Mes modules » (PUT /api/v1/tenants/me/modules/client-portal/activation): off = its invoices disappear from the portal at the next request; companies that existed before the portal start with it off, new companies with it on. Responses use Keevo's envelope: success {data, …}; error {error: French message to show, code: HTTP name, domainCode, details?}. No identifier is ever returned: show the fields as they are. Change this file only with both sides.

headers.Accept-Language: optional, fr (default) or en — language of the SMS

errors.reaction: show the message, keep the form
not a phone (an email is refused): « Saisissez un numéro de téléphone »
phone missing or too long: show the message
show the message, disable « Renvoyer le code » for a few minutes

endpoints.notes: Same answer whether the phone has invoices or not. The code goes by SMS (and WhatsApp when configured), 6 digits, valid 5 minutes. Limits shared with the merchant sign-in codes of the same phone: 3 per 10 minutes, 5 per hour, 10 per hour per network address.

errors.reaction: « Code incorrect ou expiré » — let the client retype or ask a new code
the code is dead: ask a new one
show the message, back to the phone screen
not a phone: back to the phone screen
phone or code missing: show the message
rare: the code may already be used — offer « Recevoir un nouveau code »

endpoints.notes: Store accessToken in the secure store (never in plain storage, never logged). A merchant sign-in code is refused here and a portal code is refused on /api/v1/auth/otp/verify.

items.paymentState: UNPAID | PARTIAL | PAID | OVERDUE | CANCELLED (colour only, never shown)
items.paymentStateLabel: Non payée | Partiellement payée | Payée | En retard | Annulée

errors.reaction: delete the stored token, back to the phone screen
show the message, retry after a minute
bad cursor or limit: reload from the first page

endpoints.notes: Newest first across merchants, limit 1–50 (20 by default). Keep paging while nextCursor is not null: a page may hold fewer items than the limit (an invoice no longer listable is skipped), even none, without being the last one. 'link' is null for a cancelled invoice. The link opens the invoice PDF without sign-in and stops after 24 h: never cache it, re-list to get a fresh one. Amounts are XAF integers. Online only (no offline copy).

endpoints.response: 204, no body (also when the token is unknown)
endpoints.notes: Delete the stored token whatever the answer. Too many unknown tokens from one address are ignored (still 204).
